mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id,s.source_id,a.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.title,s.classification, a.project_id,a.attempt_id,a.parse_version,a.job_type,a.config_revision,a.status,a.failure_manifest, a.request_manifest,a.run_id,a.created_by,a.created_at,a.revision,a.updated_at,p.parse_status FROM processing_attempt a JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=a.source_version JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id LEFT JOIN parse_version p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.source_version=a.source_version AND p.parse_version=a.parse_version WHERE 1=1 AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.status=#{status} ORDER BY a.attempt_id

SELECT sv.source_version,sv.rights_revision,s.owner_project_id,r.purpose FROM source_version sv JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN rights_revision r ON r.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND r.rights_revision=sv.rights_revision WHERE sv.source_version IN #{sourceVersion} ORDER BY sv.source_version

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.project_id,s.submission_id,s.artifact_id,s.artifact_owner_project_id,s.target_source_id,s.target_source_version, p.parse_version,sv.rights_revision, s.sharing_decision,s.original_evidence,s.status,s.created_by,s.created_at,s.classification,s.revision,s.updated_at FROM knowledge_submission s JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=s.target_source_version LEFT JOIN outbox_event original_event ON original_event.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND original_event.aggregate_id=s.target_source_version AND original_event.aggregate_revision=1 AND original_event.event_type='artifact.submitted_as_source' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.schema_version'))='1.0.0' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.submission_id'))=s.submission_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.artifact_id'))=s.artifact_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.source_id'))=s.target_source_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.source_version'))=s.target_source_version AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.sharing_decision'))=s.sharing_decision AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.actor_id'))=s.created_by LEFT JOIN parse_version p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.source_version=s.target_source_version AND p.parse_version=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.parse_version')) WHERE s.submission_id=#{submissionId}

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.project_id,s.submission_id,s.artifact_id,s.artifact_owner_project_id,s.target_source_id,s.target_source_version, p.parse_version,sv.rights_revision, s.sharing_decision,s.original_evidence,s.status,s.created_by,s.created_at,s.classification,s.revision,s.updated_at FROM knowledge_submission s JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=s.target_source_version LEFT JOIN outbox_event original_event ON original_event.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND original_event.aggregate_id=s.target_source_version AND original_event.aggregate_revision=1 AND original_event.event_type='artifact.submitted_as_source' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.schema_version'))='1.0.0' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.submission_id'))=s.submission_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.artifact_id'))=s.artifact_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.source_id'))=s.target_source_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.source_version'))=s.target_source_version AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.sharing_decision'))=s.sharing_decision AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.actor_id'))=s.created_by LEFT JOIN parse_version p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.source_version=s.target_source_version AND p.parse_version=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(original_event.payload,'$.parse_version')) WHERE s.artifact_id=#{artifactId} AND s.status='PENDING' AND s.project_id=#{targetProjectId}AND s.project_id IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT sv.tenant_id,sv.source_id,sv.source_version,sv.version_no,sv.publisher_version, sv.original_sha256,sv.media_type,sv.size_bytes,sv.rights_revision,ls.status AS lifecycle,sv.created_at FROM source_version sv JOIN source_lifecycle_state ls ON ls.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND ls.source_version=sv.source_version WHERE sv.source_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY sv.version_no DESC,sv.source_version DESC

SELECT tenant_id,folder_id,parent_id,owner_project_id,category,name,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at FROM source_folder WHERE owner_project_id IS NULLowner_project_id=#{ownerProjectId} ORDER BY category,name,folder_id
SELECT tenant_id,folder_id,parent_id,owner_project_id,category,name,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at FROM source_folder WHERE folder_id=#{folderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.source_id,sv.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,s.classification, o.folder_id,COALESCE(o.labels,JSON_ARRAY()) AS labels,o.revision, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_source_bookmark ub WHERE ub.user_id=#{userId} AND ub.source_version=sv.source_version) AS bookmarked FROM source_version sv JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id LEFT JOIN source_organization o ON o.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND o.source_id=s.source_id WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT CONCAT('01:',b.project_id,':',b.binding_revision) AS usage_key,'PROJECT_BINDING' AS usage_kind, 'PROJECT_APPLICABILITY' AS relation_kind,b.project_id,'PROJECT' AS resource_kind,b.project_id AS resource_id, b.binding_revision AS version_id,pr.name AS title,b.applicability AS status, IF(b.applicability='APPLICABLE','BLOCKING','OBSERVED') AS impact_status,NULL AS created_at FROM project_source_binding b JOIN project_record pr ON pr.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND pr.project_id=b.project_id WHERE b.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND b.is_current=TRUE UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('02:',cm.collection_version,':',cm.parse_version),'COLLECTION_MEMBER','COLLECTION_MEMBER', ch.owner_project_id,'COLLECTION',ch.collection_id,cm.collection_version,ch.title, IF(ch.current_version=cm.collection_version,'CURRENT','HISTORICAL'), IF(ch.current_version=cm.collection_version,'BLOCKING','HISTORICAL'),cm.created_at FROM collection_member cm JOIN collection_version cv ON cv.tenant_id=cm.tenant_id AND cv.collection_version=cm.collection_version JOIN collection_head ch ON ch.tenant_id=cv.tenant_id AND ch.collection_id=cv.collection_id WHERE cm.source_version=#{sourceVersion} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('03:',sm.project_id,':',sm.snapshot_id,':',sm.parse_version),'SCOPE_SNAPSHOT','SCOPE_MEMBER', sm.project_id,'PROJECT',sm.project_id,sm.snapshot_id,pr.name,'FIXED','BLOCKING',ss.created_at FROM scope_member sm JOIN scope_snapshot ss ON ss.tenant_id=sm.tenant_id AND ss.project_id=sm.project_id AND ss.snapshot_id=sm.snapshot_id JOIN project_record pr ON pr.tenant_id=sm.tenant_id AND pr.project_id=sm.project_id WHERE sm.source_version=#{sourceVersion} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('04:',e.project_id,':',e.evidence_id),'DOCUMENT_EVIDENCE',e.relation_kind,e.project_id, 'DOCUMENT',d.document_id,e.document_revision,NULL,e.relation_kind,'BLOCKING',m.created_at FROM evidence_link e JOIN document_revision d ON d.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND d.project_id=e.project_id AND d.document_revision=e.document_revision LEFT JOIN document_revision_meta m ON m.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND m.project_id=e.project_id AND m.document_revision=e.document_revision WHERE e.source_version=#{sourceVersion} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('05:',e.upstream_version_id,':',e.consumer_version_id,':',e.relation_kind),'LINEAGE_DEPENDENCY', e.relation_kind,v.owner_project_id,'VERSION',e.consumer_version_id,e.consumer_version_id,pr.name, v.entity_kind,'BLOCKING',e.created_at FROM lineage_edge e JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND v.version_id=e.consumer_version_id LEFT JOIN project_record pr ON pr.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND pr.project_id=v.owner_project_id WHERE (e.upstream_version_id=#{sourceVersion} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parse_version p WHERE p.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND p.parse_version=e.upstream_version_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_version sv WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND sv.rights_revision=e.upstream_version_id)) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('06:',h.upstream_version_id,':',h.hold_id),'REFERENCE_HOLD','RETENTION_HOLD',h.project_id, 'VERSION',h.consumer_version_id,h.consumer_version_id,pr.name, CASE WHEN h.legal_hold=TRUE THEN 'LEGAL_HOLD' WHEN h.retain_until IS NULL THEN 'UNBOUNDED' WHEN h.retain_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 'RETAINED' ELSE 'EXPIRED' END, CASE WHEN h.legal_hold=TRUE OR h.retain_until IS NULL OR h.retain_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 'HELD' ELSE 'EXPIRED' END, h.created_at FROM reference_hold h LEFT JOIN project_record pr ON pr.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND pr.project_id=h.project_id WHERE (h.upstream_version_id=#{sourceVersion} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parse_version p WHERE p.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND p.parse_version=h.upstream_version_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM source_version sv WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND sv.rights_revision=h.upstream_version_id))
mapper.select: SELECT s.tenant_id,s.source_id,sv.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,s.title,s.classification, sv.original_sha256,sv.media_type,sv.size_bytes,sv.rights_revision,r.purpose AS rights_purpose,r.status AS rights_status, p.parse_version,p.parse_status,i.index_version,i.mode AS index_mode,i.status AS index_status,i.expected_count,i.verified_count, g.approval_revision,g.upload_status,g.approval_status,g.lifecycle,g.revision AS gate_revision, a.decision AS current_decision,a.reviewed_manifest_sha256,a.decided_at FROM source_version sv JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN rights_revision r ON r.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND r.rights_revision=sv.rights_revision JOIN parse_version p ON p.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND p.source_version=sv.source_version JOIN source_use_gate g ON g.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND g.source_version=p.source_version AND g.parse_version=p.parse_version LEFT JOIN index_manifest i ON i.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND i.source_version=p.source_version AND i.parse_version=p.parse_version LEFT JOIN approval_decision a ON a.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND a.source_version=g.source_version AND a.parse_version=g.parse_version AND a.approval_revision=g.approval_revision WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} ORDER BY p.parse_version,i.index_version

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.source_id,sv.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,s.title,s.classification, sv.original_sha256,sv.media_type,sv.size_bytes,sv.rights_revision,r.purpose AS rights_purpose,r.status AS rights_status, p.parse_version,p.parse_status,i.index_version,i.mode AS index_mode,i.status AS index_status,i.expected_count,i.verified_count, g.approval_revision,g.upload_status,g.approval_status,g.lifecycle,g.revision AS gate_revision, a.decision AS current_decision,a.reviewed_manifest_sha256,a.decided_at FROM source_version sv JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN rights_revision r ON r.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND r.source_version=sv.source_version AND r.rights_revision=sv.rights_revision JOIN parse_version p ON p.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND p.source_version=sv.source_version JOIN source_use_gate g ON g.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND g.source_version=p.source_version AND g.parse_version=p.parse_version LEFT JOIN index_manifest i ON i.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND i.source_version=p.source_version AND i.parse_version=p.parse_version LEFT JOIN approval_decision a ON a.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND a.source_version=g.source_version AND a.parse_version=g.parse_version AND a.approval_revision=g.approval_revision WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND p.parse_version=#{parseVersion} ORDER BY p.parse_version,i.index_version LIMIT #{fetchLimit}

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.source_id,sv.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,s.title,s.classification, sv.original_sha256,sv.object_key,sv.object_version,sv.media_type,sv.size_bytes,sv.rights_revision, r.purpose AS rights_purpose,r.status AS rights_status,p.parse_version,p.parse_status,p.content_sha256,g.lifecycle FROM source_version sv JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN rights_revision r ON r.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND r.rights_revision=sv.rights_revision JOIN parse_version p ON p.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND p.source_version=sv.source_version JOIN source_use_gate g ON g.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND g.source_version=p.source_version AND g.parse_version=p.parse_version WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND p.parse_version=#{parseVersion}

SELECT v.tenant_id,h.config_id,h.project_id,v.version_id,v.entity_kind,v.content_sha256 AS registered_sha256, c.content_sha256,c.configuration_kind,c.kind AS capability_kind,c.status, c.input_schema_ref,c.output_schema_ref,c.tool_scope,c.artifact_digest FROM version_registry v JOIN capability_version c ON c.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND c.capability_version=v.version_id JOIN configuration_head h ON h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND h.config_id=c.config_id WHERE v.version_id=#{configRevision} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.tenant_id,a.project_id,a.attempt_id,a.source_version,a.parse_version,a.job_type,a.config_revision, a.status,a.failure_manifest,a.request_manifest,a.run_id,a.schema_version,a.schema_manifest_sha256,a.created_by, a.created_at,a.classification,a.revision,a.updated_at,p.parse_status,p.processor_manifest FROM processing_attempt a JOIN parse_version p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.source_version=a.source_version AND p.parse_version=a.parse_version WHERE a.attempt_id=#{attemptId}

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.source_id,sv.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,sv.original_sha256, sv.object_key,sv.object_version,sv.media_type,sv.size_bytes,s.classification,sv.created_at AS source_created_at, ls.status,ls.last_decision_id,ls.revision,pr.status AS owner_project_status FROM source_version sv JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN source_lifecycle_state ls ON ls.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND ls.source_version=sv.source_version LEFT JOIN project pr ON pr.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND pr.project_id=s.owner_project_id WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion}

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.source_id,sv.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,sv.original_sha256, sv.object_key,sv.object_version,sv.media_type,sv.size_bytes,s.classification,sv.created_at AS source_created_at, ls.status,ls.last_decision_id,ls.revision,pr.status AS owner_project_status FROM source_version sv JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN source_lifecycle_state ls ON ls.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND ls.source_version=sv.source_version LEFT JOIN project pr ON pr.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND pr.project_id=s.owner_project_id WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} FOR UPDATE
SELECT deletion_id,target_version,policy_revision,status,revision,updated_at FROM deletion_job WHERE deletion_id=#{deletionId}

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.source_id,sv.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,j.deletion_id, j.status AS job_status,j.revision AS job_revision,i.item_id,i.store_kind,i.target_ref,i.target_sha256, i.status AS item_status,i.receipt_ref,i.backup_expiry,i.revision AS item_revision, ls.status AS lifecycle_status,ls.revision AS lifecycle_revision,s.classification FROM deletion_item i JOIN deletion_job j ON j.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND j.deletion_id=i.deletion_id JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=j.target_version JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN source_lifecycle_state ls ON ls.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND ls.source_version=sv.source_version WHERE i.deletion_id=#{deletionId} ORDER BY i.store_kind,i.item_id

SELECT s.tenant_id,s.source_id,sv.source_version,s.owner_project_id,s.ownership,j.deletion_id, j.status AS job_status,j.revision AS job_revision,i.item_id,i.store_kind,i.target_ref,i.target_sha256, i.status AS item_status,i.receipt_ref,i.backup_expiry,i.revision AS item_revision, ls.status AS lifecycle_status,ls.revision AS lifecycle_revision,s.classification FROM deletion_item i JOIN deletion_job j ON j.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND j.deletion_id=i.deletion_id JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=j.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=j.target_version JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN source_lifecycle_state ls ON ls.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND ls.source_version=sv.source_version WHERE i.item_id=#{itemId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM () u WHERE u.usage_kind<>'REFERENCE_HOLD' OR u.impact_status='HELD'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deletion_item WHERE deletion_id=#{deletionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_organization WHERE folder_id=#{folderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deletion_item WHERE deletion_id=#{deletionId} AND status<>'CONFIRMED'

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name='KN-09' AND o.idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name='KN-08' AND o.idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT project_id,source_version,binding_revision,applicability,decision_manifest FROM project_source_binding b WHERE b.project_id=#{projectId} AND b.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND b.is_current=TRUE FOR UPDATE
SELECT project_id,source_version,binding_revision,applicability,decision_manifest FROM project_source_binding b WHERE b.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND b.is_current=TRUE ORDER BY b.project_id

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name='KN-10' AND o.idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name='KN-17' AND o.idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name=#{operationName} AND o.idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name='KN-20' AND o.idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name='KN-17-RECEIPT' AND o.idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name='KN-18' AND o.idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_source_binding b WHERE b.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND b.binding_revision=#{bindingRevision} AND b.is_current=TRUE AND b.applicability='APPLICABLE'
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant SET governance_epoch=governance_epoch+1 WHERE governance_epoch=#{governanceEpoch}
UPDATE project_source_binding SET is_current=FALSE WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND binding_revision=#{expectedBindingRevision} AND is_current=TRUE

UPDATE source_use_gate SET approval_revision=CASE WHEN #{decision}='RESTORE' THEN NULL ELSE approval_revision END, approval_status=CASE WHEN #{decision}='RESTORE' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'DISABLED' END, lifecycle=CASE #{decision} WHEN 'RECYCLE' THEN 'RECYCLED' WHEN 'RESTORE' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN 'PURGE' THEN 'PURGE_PENDING' ELSE lifecycle END, revision=revision+1 WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deletion_item(item_id,deletion_id,store_kind,target_ref,target_sha256,status,receipt_ref, backup_expiry,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at) SELECT UUID(),#{deletionId},targets.store_kind,targets.target_ref,targets.target_sha256,'QUEUED',NULL, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{backupExpiry},#{now}),'1.0.0',#{schemaManifest},#{userId},#{now},#{classification},1,#{now} FROM ( SELECT 'ORIGINAL' AS store_kind, JSON_OBJECT('source_version',sv.source_version,'object_key',sv.object_key,'object_version',sv.object_version, 'content_sha256',sv.original_sha256,'size_bytes',CAST(sv.size_bytes AS CHAR),'media_type',sv.media_type) AS target_ref, SHA2(CONCAT('ORIGINAL:',sv.object_key,':',sv.object_version,':',sv.original_sha256),256) AS target_sha256 FROM source_version sv WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} UNION ALL SELECT 'PARSED',JSON_OBJECT('source_version',p.source_version,'parse_version',p.parse_version, 'artifact_key',p.artifact_key,'content_sha256',p.content_sha256), SHA2(CONCAT('PARSED:',p.parse_version,':',p.artifact_key,':',p.content_sha256),256) FROM parse_version p WHERE p.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND p.artifact_key IS NOT NULL AND p.content_sha256 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'FULLTEXT',JSON_OBJECT('source_version',i.source_version,'parse_version',i.parse_version, 'index_version',i.index_version,'manifest_sha256',i.manifest_sha256), SHA2(CONCAT('FULLTEXT:',i.index_version,':',i.manifest_sha256),256) FROM index_manifest i WHERE i.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND i.mode IN ('FULLTEXT','HYBRID') UNION ALL SELECT 'VECTOR',JSON_OBJECT('source_version',i.source_version,'parse_version',i.parse_version, 'index_version',i.index_version,'manifest_sha256',i.manifest_sha256), SHA2(CONCAT('VECTOR:',i.index_version,':',i.manifest_sha256),256) FROM index_manifest i WHERE i.source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND i.mode IN ('DENSE','HYBRID') UNION ALL SELECT 'CACHE',JSON_OBJECT('source_version',sv.source_version),SHA2(CONCAT('CACHE:',sv.source_version),256) FROM source_version sv WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} UNION ALL SELECT 'DIAGNOSTIC',JSON_OBJECT('source_version',sv.source_version),SHA2(CONCAT('DIAGNOSTIC:',sv.source_version),256) FROM source_version sv WHERE sv.source_version=#{sourceVersion} ) targets
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM source_folder WHERE folder_id=#{folderId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}
DELETE FROM user_source_bookmark WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_version=#{sourceVersion}
mapper.update: UPDATE deletion_job SET status=#{jobStatus},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE deletion_id=#{deletionId} AND revision=#{expectedJobRevision} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
UPDATE source_lifecycle_state SET status='PURGED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND status='PURGE_PENDING' AND revision=#{expectedLifecycleRevision}
UPDATE source_use_gate SET lifecycle='PURGED',approval_status='DISABLED',revision=revision+1 WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND lifecycle='PURGE_PENDING'
